data.description: The 3 ft Straight Open Slide is the simplest slide in our range: a straight red and yellow chute with a steel ladder at the back and an open top. There are no turns or bumps, so the ride is predictable, which helps nervous first-time sliders build confidence. Its low height makes it a sensible first slide for a nursery or kindergarten. Teachers can see the child the whole way down, and it fits against a wall or fence because it runs in a straight line. If a manufacturing defect shows up in the steel or moulded parts within 3 years, our warranty covers it. Send us your site size and we will mark the slide and its run-out on a layout drawing.

items.pText: The 3 ft Straight Open Slide is the simplest slide in our range: a straight red and yellow chute with a steel ladder at the back and an open top. There are no turns or bumps, so the ride is predictable, which helps nervous first-time sliders build confidence. Its low height makes it a sensible first slide for a nursery or kindergarten. Teachers can see the child the whole way down, and it fits against a wall or fence because it runs in a straight line. If a manufacturing defect shows up in the steel or moulded parts within 3 years, our warranty covers it. Send us your site size and we will mark the slide and its run-out on a layout drawing.

This slide pairs a galvanised steel ladder with a weather-proof slide bed. Installation is self-standing or grouted. Plan a clear run-out zone at the foot of the slide, keep a soft surface there, and check the ladder rungs and the slide edges for wear during regular maintenance.
